issues.detail: Vault fittings and ribs left behind by the emissive vault lift. Every speaker, rib and crest groove now reads as a grey or black stamped-on bar.
issues.evidence: Polish B raised the vault eFn from 0.02-0.08 to 0.06-0.13, but bezel, bezelIn and bezelShadow have no emission, rib has e 0.02 and ribShadow has none, so they kept their old luminance. In the same column, the before/after speaker reads the same while the vault jumps: v1 column 350, before vault 175 / speaker rim 180 / slot 111; after vault 228 / speaker 180 / slot 111 (speaker/vault 1.03 -> 0.79). v5 column 490: vault 176 -> 228, speaker stays 176-181. v15 row 80: vault 226, speaker rim 177, face 172, crescent 107. v8 row 60: the rib's light face was 183 on a 173 vault (1.06x, a raised light rib) and is now 183 on 225 (0.81x), with a 167 shadow, so the ribs read as dark grooves. q06 (930 px): the speaker slashes on the vault are 186 against 231. Night q20 column 420: speaker 17-18 with a 5 px core on a 65-67 vault (0.27x), black bars on every panel. Photos: y_47301 (rA14/y301_vault crop) shows the vault speakers and joints barely distinguishable from the 240 vault, and c120 (w13: speaker 188 on a 188 vault) has the fittings at vault tone. kn_room1 shows no dark vault fittings either.
issues.fix: src/07b_ceiling.js, seat-zone vault loop (~l.212-275): pass the same eFn to everything that sits on the vault so it is lifted with it: `upper.add(vaultRib(...), null, { ...CEILMAT.rib, eFn })` and ribShadow, the crest-rib strips, the three vaultPanel bezel rings `{ ...CEILMAT.bezel, eFn }` / `{ ...CEILMAT.bezelIn, eFn }`, and emergBase. Keep bezelShadow and emerg without eFn, but scale them to the new tone: bezelShadow #8f8d89 -> about #b4b2ae (target crescent ~0.75x vault, c120). Then rib e = eFn + 0.01 so the rib face renders ~1.05x the vault. Targets: q06 speaker ring 220-235 on a 230 vault; night speaker >= 0.8x vault.

issues.detail: Outboard PSU band segmentation is sparser and fainter than in real photos
issues.evidence: ref/web/ceiling/kn_room1.jpg (real, THE Room): the under-bin PSU band is a run of narrow filler panels with dark vertical joints, about 8-10 per bin length, with oval lit units. y_47301 shows the same dense vertical pleating above the windows. The render's v9 band shows faint diagonal joints, about 4 per bin, and q16 shows almost no band structure.
